messages:
Avery: Heads up — just got off at Montgomery and theres a small umbrella pile outside the BART entrance. Muni 5/6 is crawling, someone said theres a fallen branch on Market. Anyone stuck? :umbrella:
Sam: Yup Im on the 5X. Delay confirmed, driver said single-track because a tree hit the overhead. ETA +18 mins. Bring wet socks :sweat_smile:
Priya: Im sheltering under the Bank of America awning. Saw a random guy in a cowboy hat handing out packets of napkins and dry granola bars. San Francisco vibes. :cowboy_hat_face: :grin:
Marcus: If anyone needs a spare umbrella Im at 1 Montgomery — I have one extra. Ping me and Ill pop it in the bike locker. Also can carpool folks to the Embarcadero if needed.
Zoe: Can someone post the transit links? My phone is on 12% and Im low on luck.
TransitBot: Muni alerts: https://status.sfmta.com/incident/4582 (json snippet)
```
route: 5R
status: delay
cause: obstruction on roadway
estimate: 15-25 mins
```
Avery: Thanks @TransitBot. Marcus — I might take that umbrella if it's not claimed. @Sam, want a granola bar? I owe you dry socks.
Sam: Accepting all offers. Also FYI—BART app shows normal service on Richmond line; if anyone can hop to Embarcadero and walk over, might be faster.
Priya: Vote: should we start an impromptu umbrella pool outside the office? React with :umbrella: if youd donate, :pray: if you need one.
Marcus: :umbrella:
Zoe: :umbrella:
Sam: :pray:
Avery: :umbrella:
Priya: Quick PSA: if youre commuting, consider waterproof shoes today. Learned the hard way. Also the cowboy hat granola guy is a legend.
Marcus: Heading back to lobby with the spare umbrella in 3. Anyone want me to leave it at the concierge with a note? @Avery @Zoe
Avery: Please leave it with concierge and mark "for Avery". Thanks!
Zoe: Typing from a soggy bench but morale = high. Also whoever brought a towel to the breakroom, I see you. :heart:
Sam: rolling into the office in 25. Might smell like wet dog. Beware.
Priya: 10/10 morning story. Should we make a rainy-day checklist for the #random archives? :memo:
Avery: Maybe. For now — umbrella handoff plan executed. Thanks everyone. Stay dry! :raised_hands:
